name: Stick Duel
hook: Punch, kick, block. First to three rounds wins.
how: One on one on a rooftop dojo. Punch is fast, kick hits harder and farther, and holding block soaks up most of a hit. Land punch, punch, kick for a combo that knocks them flat. Win three rounds to take the match; the winner stays on.
controls: Arrow keys with Z, X and C, or on-screen buttons
uses: The players with the most match wins.
The host's browser runs the timer, calls each K.O. and counts the rounds; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
A bot takes the empty side and blocks, punches and combos back, so you can play alone.
Every move, hit and block shows up on both screens at once.
ideas: Add a special move that charges up as you take hits
Make the fighters ninjas with swords
Add a ring-out edge to the rooftop
